relationships.subject: monosodium urate
relationships.evidence_quote: The fluorescence intensity of capsaicin-induced calcium response and TRPV1 current were increased in DRG cells from MSU-treated mice.

relationships.subject: monosodium urate
relationships.evidence_quote: MSU treatment resulted in significant inflammatory response and mechanical hyperalgesia.

key_findings: MSU-induced gouty arthritis increased capsaicin-evoked calcium responses and TRPV1 currents in DRG neurons, mainly small-diameter cells.
TRPV1 proposed as a target for gout pain.
